Homesteading played a major role in the settlement of the Sarpy valley during the 1920's. An excellent source for detailed regional and Sarpy Creek history is contained in Westmoreland Resources, 1975 h.
Historic Sites
The only sites in the area currently enrolled on the National Register of Historic sites are the Custer Battlefield and Reno-Benteen battlefield (and intervening and adjacent lands) located in the Little Bighorn valley about three miles south of Crow-Agency. Three other sites, Fort Sarpy II (near the Yellowstone River), the Kendrick Ranch (near Tullock Creek, approximately three miles west of Tract II), and the Montana Industrial Institute site (approximately eight miles above the mouth of the Big Horn River) appear to be eligible for inclusion (Westmoreland Resources, 1975 h).
